info.name: Account Account API PPC Research API API

params.name: query
params.description: Domain or URL to analyze for successful PPC keywords.

params.name: includeTerms
params.description: Comma-separated list of terms that must be present in the keyword.

params.name: includeAnyTerm
params.description: Used with includeTerms. If true: match any term (OR). If false: require all terms (AND).

params.name: excludeTerms
params.description: Comma-separated list of terms to exclude from results (e.g., branded or irrelevant terms).

params.name: excludeDomain
params.description: Domain to exclude from keyword results.

params.name: searchVolume.min
params.description: Filter by the number of searches done this past month on Google.

params.name: searchVolume.max
params.description: Filter by the number of searches done this past month on Google.

params.name: liveSearchVolume.min
params.description: Filter by the number of searches done this past month on Google. This value is refreshed each month.

params.name: liveSearchVolume.max
params.description: Filter by the number of searches done this past month on Google. This value is refreshed each month.

params.name: adCount.min
params.description: Filter by the number of total advertisers

params.name: adCount.max
params.description: Filter by the number of total advertisers

params.name: keywordDifficulty.min
params.description: Filter by how difficult it is to rank on this keyword.  This can also be called Ranking Difficulty.

params.name: keywordDifficulty.max
params.description: Filter by how difficult it is to rank on this keyword.  This can also be called Ranking Difficulty.

params.name: costPerClick.min
params.description: Filter by the average cost per click.  This will use the keyword matching option selected in `costPerClickOption`

params.name: costPerClick.max
params.description: Filter by the average cost per click.  This will use the keyword matching option selected in `costPerClickOption`

params.name: costPerClickOption
params.description: Cost per click keyword matching option to filter results by.

params.name: clicks.min
params.description: Filter by the number of total monthly clicks on the SERP for this keyword--organic and paid.

params.name: clicks.max
params.description: Filter by the number of total monthly clicks on the SERP for this keyword--organic and paid.

params.name: isQuestion
params.description: Filter on if the keyword is a question.

params.name: isTransactionalIntent

params.description: Filter by the percentage of searches that are done on mobile devices.

params.name: mobileSearchesPercentage.max
params.description: Filter by the percentage of searches that are done on mobile devices.

params.name: desktopSearchesPercentage.min

params.name: desktopSearchesPercentage.max

params.name: notClickedSearchesPercentage.min
params.description:
Filter by the percentage of searches that are not clicked.
Some keyword searches supply clear information in a featured snippet or similar displays. They don't require a click to get the information. Those will have higher percentages in this metric.

params.name: paidClickSearchPercentage.max
params.description: Filter by the percentage of clicks that go to ads.

params.name: organicClicksSearchPercentage.min
params.description: Filter by the percentage of clicks that go to organic results, not ads.

params.name: organicClicksSearchPercentage.max
params.description: Filter by the percentage of clicks that go to organic results, not ads.

params.name: monthlyCost.min
params.description: Filter by the monthly cost of the keyword.  This will use the keyword matching option selected in `monthlyCostOption`

params.name: monthlyCost.max
params.description: Filter by the monthly cost of the keyword.  This will use the keyword matching option selected in `monthlyCostOption`

params.name: monthlyCostOption
params.description: Monthly Cost keyword matching option to filter results by.

params.name: rankingHomepages.min

params.name: rankingHomepages.max
params.description: Homepages on the SERP range to filter results by.

params.name: wordCount.min
params.description: Filter by the number of words in the keyword.

params.name: wordCount.max
params.description: Filter by the number of words in the keyword.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of rows returned.

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Country market to search. Specifically, this maps to the Google domain version to query against (e.g., google.com for US, google.de for Germany, etc.). All Countries

params.name: sortBy

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Order to sort the results.

params.name: startingRow

params.name: adultFilter
params.description: Exclude adult keywords considered unsafe for work.

params.description: Only include adult keywords considered unsafe for work.

items.docs:
Returns the most successful paid search keywords for a domain based on search volume and competitive strength. This endpoint provides the highest-performing PPC keywords from the past year to identify proven advertising opportunities and optimize keyword strategy.

[Visualize this API live on SpyFu](https://www.spyfu.com/ppc/keywords?query=example.com)

items.docs:
Returns newly acquired paid search keywords that a domain has started advertising on for the first time. This endpoint identifies recent keyword expansions and emerging advertising strategies to reveal new market opportunities and competitive moves.

[Visualize this API live on SpyFu](https://www.spyfu.com/ppc/keywords?query=example.com)

params.name: query
params.description: Domain to analyze for paid search presence.

params.name: includeTerms
params.description: Comma-separated list of terms that must be present in the keyword.

params.name: includeAnyTerm
params.description: Used with includeTerms. If true: match any term (OR). If false: require all terms (AND).

params.name: excludeTerms
params.description: Comma-separated list of terms to exclude from results (e.g., branded or irrelevant terms).

params.name: searchVolume.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where monthly search volume (Google) is ≥ this value.

params.name: searchVolume.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where monthly search volume (Google) is ≤ this value.

params.name: adCount.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the number of distinct advertisers observed over the last 14 months is ≥ this value.

params.name: adCount.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the number of distinct advertisers observed over the last 14 months is ≤ this value.

params.name: keywordDifficulty.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the keyword difficulty score is ≥ this value (0-100; higher = harder to rank).

params.name: keywordDifficulty.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the keyword difficulty score is ≤ this value (0-100; higher = harder to rank).

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of rows returned.

params.name: excludeHomepageKeywords
params.description: If true, exclude keywords where the domain/URL's homepage (root domain, e.g., example.com) ranks; if false, include all.

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Country market to search. Specifically, this maps to the Google domain version to query against (e.g., google.com for US, google.de for Germany, etc.). All Countries

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Column to sort results by.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Order to sort the results.

params.name: startingRow
params.description: Row number to start the results with.

params.name: adultFilter
params.description: Exclude adult keywords considered unsafe for work.

params.name: onlyAdultKeywords
params.description: Only include adult keywords considered unsafe for work.

items.docs:
Returns paid search results (ads) that a domain appears in across Google search. This endpoint reveals the competitive paid landscape to identify advertising opportunities and understand competitor PPC strategies.

[Visualize this API live on SpyFu](https://www.spyfu.com/ppc/keywords/domain?query=example.com)
